title: scNMT-seq
scope: Clark 2018 scNMT-seq implementation depicted in the central scNMT-seq row: isolate one cell, lyse and mark accessible DNA at GpC sites, capture and separately route poly(A) RNA and genomic DNA, prepare transcriptome and scBS-seq libraries, and obtain linked expression, endogenous CpG methylation and GpC accessibility readouts. The three left-side icons describe analytes, not an initial three-way material split. Adjacent scTrio-Seq2/scBS-Seq and scCOOL-seq/NOMe-Seq/PBAT panels are context, not additional target workflows. Smart-seq2 and scBS-seq are components of this target, not separate declared methods.

corrections.diagram_observation: The action caption correctly says Lyse and GpC methylase labelling, but the lower DNA cartoon labels CpG dinucleotides and Methylated CpG and states Methylated CpG indicates accessible DNA. corrections.primary_statement: Clark 2018 identifies M.CviPI as the GpC methyltransferase used to mark accessible DNA, while endogenous methylation is read at informative CpG contexts. The graph therefore assigns introduced accessibility methylation to GpC cytosines in the lysate and separated DNA, and produces distinct CpG methylation and GpC accessibility datasets from the same DNA reads. The primary context restrictions prevent assigning overlapping or off-target contexts uncritically.
